chapter_note: This chapter is largely a compact, impersonal sequence of pre-temporal appointments within the Manichaean cosmic plan (Ambassador, ships, Judge, astral fate, destroyers, Builder). The only clear late/polemical reach beyond the closed cosmic system is the clause about "the sects" (¶5), which applies the ordination of Christ to the editor’s contemporary religious landscape.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Direct audience address and lesson-introduction formula; functions as editorial/homiletic frame rather than cosmological exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: Know that before night and day were differentiated in the universe, the Third [Am]bassador was summoned. And afterwards, he was sent to this void and outer waste that he might purify the light, and separate night and day from each other.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal cosmological sequencing (“before X… afterwards Y…”) describing a pre-temporal salvific action within the system (no citation, no institutional application).

paragraphs.core_text: Before the light was released and freed and ascended through this zone, the Father of Life made beautiful for it the ships of light. He constructed them so that it might be purified in them, and be sculpted and fashioned in good order.
paragraphs.temporal_note: System-internal salvific mechanics (Light purification via cosmic ‘ships’), in the characteristic expository voice of the teaching substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: [Bef]ore Sin had multiplied and had made a kingdom in the flesh, before the acquitted and the condemn[ed] were set apart from each other, the Judge [w]as sent forth and revealed. His throne was created and placed [i]n the living atmosphere, so that he would be a just Judge, so that there the righteous and the sinners would be set apart and tested and separated from each other.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Still framed as pre-temporal appointment and cosmic architecture (Judge, throne, living atmosphere). Although moral vocabulary (“righteous/sinners”) raises the pastoral register, it remains a system description (eschatological sorting mechanism) rather than an exhortation or church application.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, before the error and offence of the sects were displayed in the universe, the blessed Christ was ordained and brought forth
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the application/polemical purpose clause “against them, that he might render their error harmless,” because it maps the cosmic ordination outward onto contemporary ‘sects’ (cosmos → editor’s religious landscape), rather than staying within the closed cosmic system.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The pre-temporal ordination formula is consistent with the chapter’s core sequence, but the explicit targeting of ‘sects’ is an editorial/application move beyond cosmic-to-cosmic mapping. ‘Christ’ here may be the Manichaean cosmic figure, but the anti-sect framing is late in function.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, [befo]re mankind had been engendered, some were named ['rich' and] others 'poor' on earth [ ... ] upon them. Before they die, they who will die are marked out by the stars and the signs of the zodiac in the sphere. They are appointed for them; in them are their births. And their root is bound up with their zodiacal signs; and they are compelled by them and brought to an equal judgement in accordance with their deeds and their sins.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Deterministic astral-zodiacal mechanism stated as structure (“marked out,” “appointed,” “root… bound up”): cosmos → human fate within the same system, no exhortation/citation.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, before the universe is dissolved, [and the] entire earth, the destroyers were appointed and instructed for its dissolution.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic eschatological logistics in the same iterative ‘before… appointed’ style; no institutional or devotional overlay.

paragraphs.core_text: And before the ne[w] aeon was [built and] made be[auti]ful and marked out, [the] Great Builder [w]as summoned, the first architect and the angels who are with him, who would build and make beautiful the new aeon.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Closed-system cosmology (new aeon construction; Builder/architect/angels) expressed as pre-temporal planning; typical substrate scheduling motif.
